name: meter
title: Meter
summary: A level read at a glance: a row of segments that light up to the value, with its label and reading.
use: For a level that changes on its own: CPU, input gain, storage, battery.
Not for task progress; that is a progress bar.
anatomy: Segments: lit to the value, unlit on the rule

options.name: segments
options.description: How many segments the row has.

options.name: tone
options.description: The color of the lit segments. A status tone when the level has a meaning.

rules: Only lit segments take a color; everything else is ink, muted or rule.
The reading always shows the number, so color never carries the level alone.
accessibility: Exposed as a meter with its value, minimum and maximum.
